state.instructions: Dr. Okafor has just arrived at the front desk for her ten o'clock meeting. Sign her in, then stop.

__tool__.instructions: Which action best advances `instructions`, given `state` and `previous_actions`?

criteria.book_meeting_room: Reserves a meeting room for a team meeting.
criteria.order_catering: Orders food and drinks from a caterer for an event in the office.
criteria.print_document: Sends a document to one of the office printers.
criteria.reset_password: Resets the password of an employee account and emails a temporary one.
criteria.request_laptop: Requests a new laptop for an employee from IT procurement.
criteria.report_broken_light: Reports a broken light bulb or lamp to facilities.
criteria.set_thermostat: Changes the target temperature of a heating zone.
criteria.register_visitor: Signs a visitor in at the front desk: prints a visitor badge and tells their host that they have arrived.
criteria.reserve_parking_spot: Reserves a parking spot in the company car park for a day.
criteria.submit_expense: Files an expense report for money an employee spent.
criteria.request_leave: Requests time off for an employee.
criteria.order_office_supplies: Orders stationery and small supplies for the office.
criteria.schedule_cleaning: Schedules an extra cleaning of part of the office.
criteria.open_it_ticket: Opens a ticket with the IT helpdesk about a problem with a computer or a service.
criteria.book_travel: Books a business trip for an employee.
criteria.update_directory_entry: Changes one detail of an employee in the company directory.
criteria.send_company_announcement: Sends an announcement by email to a group of employees.
criteria.grant_building_access: Gives a badge access to a restricted zone of the building.
criteria.order_taxi: Orders a taxi to pick someone up at the office.
criteria.book_desk: Books a desk in the shared open space for a day.
criteria.recycle_electronics: Arranges the pickup of old electronics for recycling.
criteria.subscribe_newsletter: Subscribes an employee to an internal mailing list.
criteria.request_badge: Requests a new or replacement access badge for an employee.
criteria.file_complaint: Files a complaint with the facilities team about the workplace.
criteria.rent_bike: Reserves a company bike for a trip around town.
criteria.refill_coffee_machine: Asks for the coffee machine to be refilled with beans and water.
criteria.start_fire_drill: Starts the scheduled fire evacuation drill for a building.
criteria.archive_documents: Sends old paper documents to long-term storage.
criteria.renew_software_license: Renews a paid software licence before it expires.
criteria.schedule_interview: Schedules a job interview with a candidate.
criteria.end: Stops, because `instructions` have been carried out according to `state`, or cannot be carried out.
